provenance: Native omadesign WGPU viewport recordings. Seeded example documents; actual egui pointer and keyboard input during replay. The only overlay is a pointer indicator. No audio.

chapters.label: Gradient placement
chapters.description: Drag the native canvas handles to place and reshape the fill gradient.

chapters.label: Gradient direction
chapters.description: Drag a new direction for the selected gradient.

chapters.label: Group and undo
chapters.description: Group artwork, ungroup, undo and redo.

chapters.label: Compare and sample
chapters.description: Compare original and preview, then sample the key color.

chapters.label: Apply and undo
chapters.description: Apply the key, undo and redo.

chapters.label: Reopen preview
chapters.description: Reopen the chroma key preview and cancel.

chapters.label: Present
chapters.description: Open the native interactive Layout presentation.

chapters.label: Draw a frame
chapters.description: Use the Frame tool to draw a new frame.

chapters.label: Undo
chapters.description: Undo the new frame in the native workspace.

chapters.label: Light
chapters.description: Adjust exposure and shadows, then compare the original with Before.

chapters.label: Color
chapters.description: Warm the scene slightly and adjust vibrance in the Color panel.

chapters.label: Detail
chapters.description: Add a gentle clarity and vignette adjustment.

chapters.label: Compare
chapters.description: Return to Light controls and compare the developed image with Before.

chapters.label: Presets
chapters.description: Apply Draw stroke to the selected rings and play the actual animation.

chapters.label: Keyframes
chapters.description: Add a key with the native keyboard shortcut and undo it.

chapters.label: Pop in
chapters.description: Apply Pop in and play the resulting animation.

chapters.label: Slide up
chapters.description: Apply Slide up and play the resulting animation.

chapters.label: Layers
chapters.description: Compare blend modes and play the edited animation.

chapters.label: Palettes
chapters.description: Choose colors from two project palettes and apply them to the selected shape.

chapters.label: Brand assets
chapters.description: Filter the project asset bank, drag an SVG onto the artboard, and undo its placement.

chapters.label: Typography
chapters.description: Apply project Heading and Body font roles to the selected headline.
